title: 德莱厄斯·红围巾
description: 黑发德莱厄斯穿厚重红黑护甲，坐在矮凳上认真补围巾，大斧安放侧架。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Darius is a broad adult Noxian man with short black hair, a stern square face, heavy dark metal armor, red cloth accents, and a thick fur-edged collar. Keep his fully armored torso, covered legs, and sturdy boots recognizable while softening his expression. His enormous broad-bladed axe rests securely in a low wooden holder, entirely inactive and well clear of his hands.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a low bench and carefully threads a short red scarf through his large gloved fingers, fixing a loose tassel with an amused frown. A plain sewing basket and a cup occupy a small side table. The axe stays on its rack, and a simple warm window makes this a quiet domestic interlude.
art_direction.palette: charcoal gray, warm red, cream, muted brass
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
